test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

RAT : IZG :: YUM : BFN :: SIP : ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f00a29e7d09d40713a3050a43d5d047106eb8fa30fa92052d773575490b9748.png] 

**Logic:** Opposite alphabet is written.

RAT : IZG →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c08101ef1341964d61b325e16c57c5e48e4d19fb9d2a6a606cef70b9a3f7c2d8.png] 

YUM : BNF →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72b9d16bbc6703d0e61b13ec9716a5913a17db5247dc0a17676dfe3cdf11102e.png] 

Similarly, for 'SIP : ?' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58281a87a7b3664db22c1f5236776bdf79754ca83ea084c6e7fe1bebef0b49c9.png] 

Here, **'SIP : HRK' **is the correct pair.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
